Hi everyone. I need to make a decision on the production rollout plan for the authentication-library patch. As a reminder, the patch addresses a critical vulnerability and has passed our security team's lab tests. The current draft proposes a Thursday 02:00 UTC canary for 60 minutes, followed by broad deployment on Friday.

Before I can approve any plan, our release policy requires a final round-robin check with application platform, reliability, and compliance. I need to hear from each of those areas and record any required rollout changes before approval. Can the representatives from application platform, reliability, and compliance each share their review and any changes they need incorporated into the plan?
